verdict.rationale: Heap documents server-side HTTP APIs for sending events, identifying users, and deleting users. These are data-ingestion and administration building blocks, not a documented way to run the product headlessly or in CI. The evidence shows no CLI, no CI integration, and no documented headless way to run analyses or reports, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
